scope: Presenter navigation and safe mode transfer; not model-quality or event qualification.

behavior.header_exit: Back to Free Mode on Ready and every presenter scene.
behavior.closing_exit: Larger return button on both the measured session view and the final closing message.
behavior.ownership: Stops owned presenter tasks and preparation, drains local work before admitting Free Mode jobs.
behavior.session_cleanup: Ends and clears the current presentation like the existing reset; download outputs before leaving.
behavior.preparation: Exit performs no new model inference, rehearsal or model reload. Normal reset behavior is unchanged.
behavior.failure: A failed transfer stays visible and retryable; concurrent switches and foreign-origin requests are rejected.

browser.scope: Layout replay of archived real fictional presenter states; actual mode switch tested separately

tests: Actual reset/cancellation/session cleanup with no preparation; completed-step mode ownership; drain/race protection; foreign-origin protection; browser retry after error.
limits: Scene layouts, including step 05, replay archived fictional presenter data. The live hardware checks exited an actual completed opening scene, an active Agent scene and active preparation.
